device: iPhone 13 Pro Max (A15), iOS 27.2, free Apple ID signing
note: Values copied from the app's speech-results.json after each Lab run. Every run below was in airplane mode, recorded by the app as 'offline (no network path)'. Score = word error rate (WER) after normalization, and key facts found / 11. Real-voice and cloned-voice audio stays on the phone and the Mac, never in the repo; only scores and the number errors are kept. Answer key: docs/demo/audio/answer-key.json.

engines.apple: SpeechTranscriber + SpeechAnalyzer, iOS 27.2, preset .transcription, language assets installed once online (en already present, fr 15 s)
engines.whisper: WhisperKit 1.1.1, openai_whisper-large-v3-v20240930_626MB (598 MB on disk), temperature 0, VAD chunking unless noted, model + tokenizer copied to the phone, download: false

apple_status.fr_FR: supported, installed after a 15 s download

mac_voices.audio: debrief-en.m4a Samantha 78 s, debrief-fr.m4a Thomas 84 s
mac_voices.apple en: WER 7.8%, facts 10/11 (miss was a scorer gap: 'December 15th, 2026', fixed and tested), 1.8 s
mac_voices.whisper fr run 1 (vad): WER 33.2% (67 deletions), facts 9/11, 75.5 s: about 30 s of audio silently missing from the transcript

cloned_voice.audio: the tester's own voice, cloned (ElevenLabs Multilingual v2), 99 s; noise mixed by scripts/mix_noise.py at exactly 10 dB SNR
cloned_voice.time: apple 1.9-2.0 s, whisper 11-23 s, per 99 s

real_voice.audio: the tester (non-native English speaker) reading the English script into the phone mic, raw (measurement mode)

quiet room (20.8 dB loud-to-quiet frames.apple: WER 13.5%, facts 10/11 (miss: 'in voice 14', a word error; every number right), 2.2 s

loud cafe + road noise from the Mac spea.apple: WER 39.1%, facts 6/11, 2.5 s; number errors: 'kilometer of 80' (18), '8.500 hours' (8.5 million), 'December of 2020' (2026)
loud cafe + road noise from the Mac spea.whisper run 1: WER 31.0%, facts 9/11; '$8,500' (8.5 million); invented 'Thank you.' and a repeated sentence

whisper_load_and_memory.note: os_proc_available_memory, not a peak trace; Apple's transcriber runs in a system process, so the app's own memory does not show its cost

scorer_changes_after_seeing_results: English dates in one order: 'December 15th, 2026' = '15 December 2026'
'8.5 million' = '$8500000' = '8,500,000'; '480 thousand' = '480000' (exact decimal; '85 million' stays different)
each change test-first and mutation-checked; every one only makes the same value match, never a different value
